name: How are plumbing lines connected when building a home addition or basement bathroom?

mainEntity.name: How are plumbing lines connected when building a home addition or basement bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adding a bathroom to a home addition or basement involves tying into the existing main water supply and sewer line. For a new addition, the distance to the main sewer line dictates the trenching and grade slope required for proper drainage. In a basement remodel, if the main sewer line exits the foundation above floor level, you must install a sewage ejector pump system or trench concrete to access gravity drains. Assessing these connection points early helps clarify overall project complexity.
acceptedAnswer.description: New bathrooms connect to the main water supply and sewer line via subfloor trenching, existing floor joists, or sewage ejector pumps if drainage sits below the sewer exit.
